parameters.name: Dealed
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the vulnerability has been handled. Valid values:
- **y**: handled
- **n**: not handled.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the asset group.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: Level
parameters.description:
The vulnerability level. Separate multiple levels with commas (,). Valid values:

- **high**: high
- **medium**: medium
- **low**: low.

parameters.name: Necessity
parameters.description:
The priority level of vulnerability fixing. Separate multiple levels with commas (,). Valid values:

- **asap**: high
- **later**: medium
- **nntf**: low.

parameters.name: Remark
parameters.description: The asset information for the vulnerability query. You can set this parameter to the asset name, public IP address, or private IP address. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: StatusList
parameters.description:
The fix status of the vulnerability. Separate multiple statuses with commas (,). Valid values:

- **1**: unfixed
- **2**: fix failed.

parameters.name: TargetType
parameters.description:
The query type. Valid values:

- **containerId**: container ID
- **uuid**: asset ID.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of vulnerability to query. Valid values:

- **cve**: Linux software vulnerability
- **sys**: Windows system vulnerability.

parameters.name: VpcInstanceIds
parameters.description: The instance IDs of VPC-connected instances to query for vulnerabilities. Separate multiple instance IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: VulNames
parameters.description:
The collection of vulnerability names.
> You can call the [DescribeGroupedVul](~~DescribeGroupedVul~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
